generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A canonical generic/commercial identity guard can be correct while a direct catalog consumer or textual fallback accepts a result without crossing that guard, allowing broad aliases or explicit commercial evidence to resolve inconsistently.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Fix only the preflight helper or add a mozzarella-specific exception, while direct resolution, fallback and public image consumers continue to accept generic references for branded or ambiguous inputs.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Every consumer that accepts a catalog/TACO or fallback nutrition result must apply the same compatibility and explicit-commercial-evidence guard before producing a verified result.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Exercise direct catalog resolution, textual fallback and public image paths with generic positives, orthographic aliases, broad aliases, explicit brands/variants and catalog misses; reject any path that diverges from the canonical guard.

transfer_cases.scenario: A broad alias or explicit brand reaches the source-text fallback.
transfer_cases.expected: The shared guard rejects unsafe generic substitution.

transfer_cases.scenario: An unbranded generic image and a branded/variant image reach the public image path.
transfer_cases.expected: Equivalent generic inputs resolve consistently and branded inputs remain fail-closed.

transfer_cases.scenario: A direct catalog/TACO result is offered beside an incompatible commercial description.
transfer_cases.expected: The invalid relation is not accepted or persisted as verified.

skill_changes.evidence: The direct catalog, final consumer and textual fallback paths share the exact-head generic/commercial guard.
Adversarial controls cover generic, alias, broad, branded, variant, catalog-miss and public-path cases.
